thread:
Ava: Quick idea — mini desk snowman contest! Build a tiny snowman out of office supplies or post pics of snowmen. Winner gets a pack of holiday stickers. Post pics here!

Micah: Ooh yes. I'm in. Where do we vote? :snowman: :tada:

Priya: I'll start a simple emoji poll. React to the post with :1st_place_medal: for favorites?

Ava: Cool. Post photos in this thread and I'll collect reactions.

Jorge: Here's mine — marshmallow + binder clip scarf. (photo attached) :snowman_with_scarf:

Leah: haha love the binder clip scarf. adding mine — mini origami hat + sticky note scarf. :sparkles:

Sam: tiny clay snowman, 2cm tall. photo coming.

Micah: Also pro-tip: keep them away from the window AC, they get crispy.

Priya: Poll: which accessory is best — binder clip scarf, sticky-note scarf, clay buttons, or origami hat. React with :one: :two: :three: :four: (I will tally at noon PT)

Ava: I'm tabulating after noon PT. May the cutest snowman win. :santa: :sparkles:

DevOpsBot: Reminder: office kitchen closing for cleaning at 1pm — don't leave snowpeople in the sink. :robot_face:

Leah: noted. quick logistics — can people drop physical entries at my desk (3rd floor) if they want them judged in person?

Sam: yes, dropping mine now.

Jorge: Dropped mine, left a tiny note: "For contest". :memo:

Priya: Vote update: current top is Micah's marshmallow + binder clip. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Ava: Congrats Micah! I'll DM Ops for the sticker pack. Winner announcement in the general holiday thread later. Good vibes y'all. :heart:
